描述_EN: barham used acrylic shapes as her printing blocks. each piece is printed to leave a fine white line between it and the adjacent shapes, so that it is clear how each letter has been constructed. the objective of the puzzle is to form a specific shape (given only an outline or silhouette) using all seven pieces, which may not overlap. a tangram is a dissection puzzle comprising 7 flat shapes (square, triangular and trapezoid) which are put together to form shapes. it is one of the most popular dissection puzzles in the world. it was originally invented in china during the song dynasty and then carried over to europe by trading ships in the early 19th century. her letters are clever and elegant solutions to the challenge of devising an alphabet from tangram pieces. this print (the letter q) comes from a series of prints comprising a tangram alphabet devised by the artist anna barham.
描述_ZN: 巴哈姆用亚克力形状作为她的印刷块。 每一块的印刷都会在它和相邻的形状之间留下一条细小的白线，这样就可以清楚地看到每个字母是如何构成的。 谜题的目的是用所有的七块拼图形成一个特定的形状（只给定一个轮廓或剪影），这些碎片可能不会重叠。 七巧板是一个由7个平面形状（正方形、三角形和梯形）组成的解剖谜题，它们被拼在一起形成形状。 它是世界上最受欢迎的解剖拼图之一。 它最初是在中国宋代发明的，然后在19世纪初由商船带到了欧洲。 她的字母是对用七巧板设计字母表的挑战的巧妙而优雅的解决方案。 这个印刷品（字母q）来自于艺术家Anna Barham设计的七巧板字母系列印刷品。
